My Salutations to all Pious Souls...

Today was the 'sixth day' of the 'life consecration' ceremony of the Shree Mangal Murti which is going to take place during the auspicious festival of Navratri.

In today's Anushthan, the Guru-energies were invited and a prayer offered to them for the overall progress of the 'donor', 'donors' because of whose donation itself this grand construction work was made possible. (I pray to) Paramatma that those who were made 'mediums' and because of whom the Guru-energies have created this 'light of knowledge' of the 'future generations' should progress a lot in their profession, business Today's Anushthan took place from morning 8.30 to 3.30pm.

Lots of Blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
